title: Independent reading: Acts 9:1–19
subtitle: Track narrative action, vision speech, and passive forms.
overview: The Damascus scene alternates between rapid aorist events and direct speech. Build the event skeleton first, then attach the participial and locative detail.
Passive and divine-agent language should be read grammatically before it is given a theological label.

items.en: Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?

items.grc: ἀνάστηθι καὶ εἴσελθε εἰς τὴν πόλιν, καὶ λαληθήσεταί σοι ὅ τί σε δεῖ ποιεῖν.
items.en: Rise and enter the city, and it will be told to you what you must do.
